editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The teacher explains while the Codex working conversation acts; Cowork uses the written projection. Checkpoints distinguish observed, draft, approved and tested states and locate saved steps and the actual result. Native live receipts and local process reports were inspected.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The saved local process, report, capability and receipts show the actual Invoice confirmation. The two clean live replay receipts finalize only this fictional local capability; they do not qualify a real accounting portal or ordinary-use performance. The learner reviews the actual proposed procedure before authoring.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice reuses the saved procedure for DEMO-B and Credit note. The actual confirmation changes accordingly, with separate attempt directories preserving all original demo outputs. Repeat instructions ask for site, task and intended result rather than assuming an arbitrary site is supported.
editorial.language_and_pacing: All it lesson prose and input notes were read. English page labels are disclosed. The outline totals 390 seconds; setup, actual approval, execution or questions can extend it. No claim is made that a timed learner session occurred.
